question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

"To stand one's ground"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. To refuse to change opinion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To stand one's ground"** means to maintain one's position and refuse to yield or give in to opposition or pressure. (अपनी स्थिति पर अडिग रहना)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the criticism, she stood her ground and continued with her original plan.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To refuse to change opinion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To give up** (हार मान लेना): To stop trying or abandon an effort.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to give up on her dream of becoming an artist.
 
 
 
• **Arranged in order** (क्रम में व्यवस्थित): Items placed in a sequential or organized manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The books were neatly arranged in order on the shelf.
 
 
 
• **To give in** (झुक जाना): To yield or surrender to pressure or demands.
 
 
• **Example:** After hours of arguing, he finally gave in and agreed to their terms.
